cases.title: Copy 成功显示 Copied；剪贴板失败显示 copy failed。
covered_dimensions: real generated Native command preview present in secure context
user clicked actual Copy control and navigator.clipboard.readText exactly matched displayed command bytes/hash
write permission denied on owned origin/context; sentinel remained unchanged after actual Copy click
fresh manual-fallback instruction observed, indicating copy did not occur
permission restored; actual Copy again matched preview exactly
clipboard cleared to zero bytes; baseline permission state restored
owned pending Node UI deleted; exact GET404, absent from list, protected five remained online/synced
cases.limitation: UI DELETE response status was not captured because the listener grouped two responses for the same path without correlating requestId; no retry was made. Deletion effect is proven by exact GET404 and list absence.
